ICSE 2027 (Synthetic Fixture) Paper #1 FlakeLens: Detecting Flaky Tests from CI Logs
===========================================================================

Review #1A [r2]
===========================================================================

Overall merit
-------------
2. Weak reject

Reviewer expertise
------------------
Y. I am knowledgeable in this area.

Paper summary
-------------
The paper propose FlakeLens, a tool that detects flaky tests from CI logs by comparing reruns of the same commit. Authors evaluate it on 40 Java projects and report a precision of 0.81.

Strengths
---------
Problem is relevant for practitioners, and the tool is available online together with the scripts for the evaluation.

Weaknesses
----------
The baseline is weak; the comparison only uses a rerun heuristic from 2019. This makes the results hard to judge. The threats section do not discuss how the 40 projects were selected.

Detailed comments for authors
-----------------------------
Please report recall and not only precision. The paper should also explain how many reruns are needed and what is the cost in CI minutes, time and money.
